Starting balance — Special Account — Edit

This form is the place where you can set up starting balance for special account.

The form includes the following fields:

Special Account

Select special account that you have created under Special Accounts tab.

Starting balance

Select whether starting balance represents debit or credit amount. Typically, you select Debit for asset account and Credit for liability accounts.

Starting balance

Enter the opening balance amount for this special account. This represents the special account balance at the beginning of your accounting period in Manager.
